meta.name: eol-process
meta.description: Run a product sunset end to end — decide, align, plan, prepare, announce, close. Use when you need the whole EOL process, not just one artifact.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从决策到收尾,跑通产品退市全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正负责产品停止服务的完整流程
copy.tagline_en: Run a full product end-of-life process from decision to closure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're managing the complete process of retiring a product

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把产品退市拆成六步走:决定、对齐、计划、准备、公布、收尾,每步之间有决策点,并产出对应清单或材料。它可按影响大小调流程规模,也允许从任意一步进入或回退。
howto.when: 当你说需要完整的产品停运流程、而不是单个交付物时触发;已公告后出问题也能从中间切入排查。

say.text: 我们决定停用旧报表模块,还没开始,走一遍完整流程。
say.note: Claude 会从决定阶段开始,问清情况后逐步推进。

say.text: 三周前发了停运通知,现在客服被打爆,我们漏了哪步?
say.note: 会按症状定位被跳过的阶段并给出补救。

say.text: 这是个内部小工具,按轻量级停运来安排。
say.note: 会按 Level 1 压缩流程。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude orchestrates a product retirement in six phases — Decide, Align, Plan, Prepare, Announce, Close — with a decision point between each, producing checklists and artifacts. It can be sized to intensity and entered at any phase, skipping or revisiting steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for the whole EOL process, not just one artifact; also when you're mid-sunset and something is going wrong.

say_en.text: We announced the sunset three weeks ago and Support is drowning. What did we skip?
say_en.note: Maps the symptom to the skipped phase and fixes it.

say_en.text: This is a small internal tool; keep the process light.
say_en.note: Sizes it as a Level 1 sunset.
